svg.title: Tactoread
svg.desc: A square lithophane plate seen face-on and lit from the upper left. Across the top, the word DNA in braille sits above a raised separator ridge. Below it a DNA double helix is embossed into the plate itself, the two backbones as curved ridges and the base pairs as short raised sticks, each casting a soft shadow across the surface. One corner of the plate is chamfered.
